views.text: In October 2020, Equity Mates discussed Exxon Mobil after its removal from the Dow, saying low oil prices risked reserve write-downs because fields only profitable at higher prices could not be booked, which challenged future production and profits.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In June 2021, Equity Mates compared financing flows to industry spending and said Exxon Mobil invested about 7 billion in exploration and drilling over five years, which framed how much it was ploughing back into finding new reserves.

In October 2020, Equity Mates said many oil companies, including Exxon Mobil, had been poor performers and had over distributed through dividends and debt-fuelled buybacks, highlighting capital allocation choices that constrained flexibility.
